firmware.description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
CN5-16.3.0.150SP16(OP009PF001AZ)

Camera
· Fixed the issue where the screen briefly flashed black when swiping after taking a photo and tapping the thumbnail.
· Optimized camera shutter response and burst shooting smoothness for a more seamless shooting experience.

Calls
· Optimized audio stability during calls in weak network conditions for clearer, more stable sound.
· Fixed the issue where switching from Mobile Data to Wi-Fi could briefly interrupt connectivity in some scenarios, making network transitions smoother.

Home Screen
· Fixed the issue where the home screen layout displayed incorrectly after a system update.
· Fixed the issue where the lock screen wallpaper appeared inconsistent after a system update.
· Fixed the occasional issue where badges did not appear on the app icons.

Performance

· Fixed the issue where the More menu could lag when opened from the photo sharing screen in AI Gallery, making sharing smoother.
· Fixed the issue where the notification shade responded slowly when swiping down, making interactions smoother.
· Fixed the issue where swiping through the screenshot preview after taking a regular screenshot could stutter, so browsing screenshots is now smoother.
· Optimized the disappearing animation for floating notifications to reduce stutter and make transitions smoother.

Reminding
· Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
